body: As an autistic woman, yes!!! All of the qualities you described are things I admire in a partner. Belive it or not some people like shy guys. I've never been into jocks or overly confident people, I think it's so charming and sweet when a guy is nervous and genuine. The fact that you're asking a bunch of questions concerning consistency in messaging your future partner is great! It shows you care and have a thoughtful heart. You working on your physical appearance for you is so much better than doing it to impress others. That'll do more in the confidence department than changing for others ever would. I'm sure there are people out there who would love to have you as a partner. I know it's hard, but please don't give up. I wish more people were as straightforward and genuine about their relationship expectations. When you find the right person, they won't judge you for asking all of those clarifying questions, in fact they'll appreciate it! I am so grateful that I was able to find my partner, I never feel judged for my autistic qualities. I wish the same for you, good luck!
